# npm audit allowlist
#
# Advisories listed here are *accepted* and do not fail the Security Audit
# workflow. Each entry needs a comment explaining why, plus a removal condition
# so the exemption does not quietly become permanent.
#
# Only use this for advisories where no patched version exists to upgrade to.
# If a fix is ever released, delete the entry immediately.

# GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm — braces <3.0.4, stack exhaustion via deeply nested
# patterns. `braces@3.0.3` is the newest release on the registry, so there is
# no version to bump to.
#
# Reachable only through dev-only lint/watch tooling, never shipped:
#   frontend: eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces
#   backend:  nodemon -> chokidar -> braces
# Both are build/lint-time only; `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean in both
# workspaces.
#
# Removal condition: drop once braces >=3.0.4 ships, or once
# eslint-config-next and nodemon drop the vulnerable chain.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm
